scenarios.prompt: Our outbound reminder agent greets immediately on connect, and when answering machine detection says 'uncertain' we treat it as a human. Review this. Name the skill you used.

forbidden.why: Must not keep uncertain as human

criteria: Treats uncertain as not human: probe, then branch

examples.pass: voice-telephony: do not greet before AMD returns. An uncertain result is not human: say a short self-contained line as a probe, then branch.
examples.fail: voice-telephony: treating uncertain as human is fine; greet right away.

scenarios.prompt: We are moving our voice agent from a web demo to a phone number and want to record calls. What changes? Name the skill you used.

forbidden.why: Must not assume HD audio on PSTN

criteria: Announces recording in the first utterance

examples.pass: voice-telephony: the line is 8 kHz narrowband, so retest STT. Announce recording in the first agent utterance.
examples.fail: voice-telephony: keep the HD audio settings from the web demo and record silently.
